title: llm.yaml
description: Provider config, role -> model/fallbacks/max_tokens, egress classes -> provider policy per license_class, and budget defaults (10-design §8, §9.1; 20-technical §8). Secrets never live here: the provider key is read from the env var named by provider.api_key_env.

providers.description: further transports a role may name (roles.<r>.provider, D714); a role without one uses `provider`.

roles.description: role name -> model config; workflow.llm_role keys must exist here.

transport.description: The wire counterparty every call routes through (e.g. openrouter); a transport is not itself a sanctioned provider — the gate is over the model-id's provider prefix (§8).

provider_prefixes.description: model-id prefix (before '/') -> egress provider slug; how a role model/fallback is mapped to a `providers` entry for gating (§8).

by_license_class.description: license_class -> egress rule; corpus text never ships to a provider not listed (EXEC-7).

pricing.description: USD per 1M tokens; drives ledger reservations (D36) and the actual cost when a response has no usage.cost. A model without an entry is priced at `fallback`.

api_key_env.description: env var holding the API key (never the key itself)

dialect.description: the request's wire shape (D714, D722): openrouter (default), openai (the OpenAI API itself) or anthropic (the Anthropic Messages API)

strip_model_prefix.description: removed from the model id on the wire only (D714)

timeout_s.description: socket timeout of this provider's requests, seconds (D714); default the transport's

egress_provider.description: egress slug of the counterparty for every model this provider serves (a direct API, D722); unset = by the model id's prefix (egress.provider_prefixes)

stream.description: dialect anthropic only: server-sent events reassembled by the transport (keepalive pings on long calls, D722)

retired.description: Prices historical rows only: no role may name the model; the client refuses new calls.

cached_in_usd_per_m.description: cached-input rate for replies without usage.cost (D714); unset = in_usd_per_m

cache_write_usd_per_m.description: cache-write rate for replies without usage.cost (D714); unset = in_usd_per_m

long_above_tokens.description: prompt tokens above which `long` prices the call

model.description: provider/model string, pinned exactly after verify-at-setup

max_tokens.description: explicit max_tokens is mandatory on every call (EXEC-2)

reasoning_effort.description: sent as OpenRouter's reasoning: {effort}; absent = the provider default (techpipe D612)

provider.description: an llm.providers entry the role's calls go to instead of `provider` (D714); a transport choice, in no digest. A model reference `<provider>:<model id>` (model, fallbacks, plan pins) overrides it per model (D722)

providers.description: sanctioned providers; empty [] means this class never ships to any LLM (if configured).

allow_fallbacks.description: whether role fallbacks may engage for this class; restricted/shadow set false (only the sanctioned providers list, no fallback drift). Default true (§8).
